metric_spec.across_cell_figure: all10 cell point estimates; source/window AUROC versus continuation AUROC; Pearson/Spearman descriptive only, no p-value or selection
metric_spec.asked: true-arm mean-pair AUROC<=0.60 in every cell
metric_spec.bootstrap: resample64test lexical_id clusters with replacement, preserving A/B and sharing identical draws across cells and channels; fixed dev fits
metric_spec.continuation: mean of both already frozen E15 pairs; no E17 validity selection; no sign flip
metric_spec.controls: report every frozen candidate pair and mean for true/random_donor/opposite_swap; signed recipient-label orientation, no control exclusion rule
metric_spec.late_aggregation: both short_late-long_early and long_late-long_early must hold separately; no pooled late score
metric_spec.lens_direction_holds: every registered contrast point>=0.10, paired95%percentile CI lower>0, and row Holm-adjusted p<=0.05
metric_spec.multiplicity: Holm step-down across exactly3 rows, alpha0.05; report adjusted p
metric_spec.outcome: row structural direction = lens_direction_holds and source_flat; spans direction requires both paren and string, list direction requires list; both=SUPPORTED, one=PARTIAL, neither=NOT_SUPPORTED; window/asked predictions assessed separately and full prediction held only if all components hold
metric_spec.p_value: (1+number of bootstrap contrasts<=0)/(2000+1); one-sided percentile-bootstrap tail approximation
metric_spec.probe: one per feature/channel; pooled dev cells; W1 mats.probes.fit_logreg lambda=1e-3, default200LBFGS iterations, train-only standardization
metric_spec.row_p_value: maximum of both late contrast p-values for paren/string; single contrast p for list
metric_spec.source_flat: every matching source contrast absolute point<=0.05; show CI, no equivalence claim
metric_spec.window: report corresponding signed differences and95%CIs; direction positive is a descriptive component, no effect-size/significance cutoff
